title: After scroll
description: Home feed into an article. The paywall appears after a short scroll, with Basic and All Access plans, App Store pay sheet, purchase confirmation, and the unlocked article.
author: Meaz Hajdarovic

title: On landing
description: Same flow, but the paywall appears as soon as the article opens, before any scrolling.
author: Meaz Hajdarovic

title: In article
description: The article opens fully readable. Scrolling down fades the text into a paywall placed in the article; scrolling back up keeps the article visible.
author: Meaz Hajdarovic
